Aliased to the maintained @xhmikosr/decompress fork instead of a plain version bump: verified both are ESM with an identical `export default decompress(input, output, options)` signature, and shellcheck already passes its own plugins explicitly (decompressTarXz/decompressUnzip) rather than relying on decompress's bundled defaults, so this is a clean drop-in. Remove once shellcheck migrates off the abandoned package upstream.
//overrides.babel-preset-expo: Monorepo hoisting: expo@55.0.28 wants babel-preset-expo 55.0.24 but apps/mobile devDep ^55.0.15 resolved 55.0.22, so two copies hoisted. babel-preset-expo gates its expo-router inline plugin on require.resolve('expo-router') from its own dir; the split + expo-router being the only un-hoisted expo-* dep meant the root copy couldn't see expo-router and skipped the EXPO_ROUTER_APP_ROOT inline → production bundle 'Invalid call'. Pin one version so expo-router hoists to root and resolves. Remove once expo/app align on one babel-preset-expo.
//overrides.nanoid: GHSA-2v37-7h3g-55p8 (high, custom generators loop indefinitely when size is zero; vulnerable <3.3.17). Every reachable copy is transitive on the 3.x line — postcss (^3.3.16) plus @react-navigation/* and expo-router (^3.3.8/^3.3.11) — and resolved to 3.3.16. Scoped to each PARENT, not a version-scoped `nanoid@3` key: that key mis-applies exactly as `js-yaml@3` did before #595 — it let postcss float to nanoid@6.0.1, violating its own ^3.3.16 range (nanoid 4+ is ESM-only, so that breaks every CJS consumer). Parent scoping pins each to >=3.3.17 <4 (resolves 3.3.18) and leaves the legitimate 6.x line alone. Remove once these packages ship nanoid >=3.3.17.
//overrides.@expo/log-box: Monorepo hoisting (paired with babel-preset-expo above): expo-router@55.0.17 has an exact peer @expo/log-box@55.0.13, which itself pulls @expo/dom-webview → expo → @expo/log-box (circular peer). npm couldn't dedupe the two identical 55.0.13 copies to root, so expo-router stayed nested in apps/mobile and the root babel-preset-expo still couldn't resolve('expo-router'). Pinning @expo/log-box to one version collapses the circular copies so expo-router hoists. Remove alongside the babel-preset-expo override once expo-router's peer tree dedupes on its own.
//overrides.hono: @prisma/dev hard-depends on hono ^4.12.8, so as soon as apps/api moves to 4.13.x npm keeps 4.12.x hoisted at the root for prisma and nests 4.13.x under apps/api. The @hono/* companions (swagger-ui, zod-openapi, zod-validator, node-server) hoist to the root and bind their peer hono to the ROOT copy, while app.ts imports Hono from the nested one - two distinct type identities for Context/Env, so app.get('/docs', swaggerUI(...)) fails typecheck with 'MiddlewareHandler<Env> is not assignable'. Forcing one hono line collapses both copies; this is why the hono and prisma dependabot PRs (#601/#530/#545/#501) sat unmergeable for weeks. Kept as a RANGE, not a pin, so routine 4.x bumps do not re-block on this entry. GOTCHA: editing this alone is not enough - npm caches the old resolution, so delete the */node_modules/hono keys from package-lock.json before npm install. Remove once @prisma/dev's hono dep catches up.
//overrides.prisma: apps/api and apps/e2e declare the SAME @prisma/client range, yet npm still installs a private copy in each workspace instead of hoisting. With nothing at the root, node_modules/.bin/prisma is never created - and that is the path the build invokes, so Typecheck/Test/E2E die with 'Cannot find module node_modules/.bin/prisma'. On the older pinned version it happened to hoist, which is why this only appeared when dependabot bumped it (#545/#501 sat unmergeable). Same hoisting quirk as babel-preset-expo and @expo/log-box above; same remedy - pin one version so it hoists. Kept as a RANGE so routine 7.x bumps do not re-block. GOTCHA: editing this alone is not enough - delete the */node_modules/prisma and */node_modules/@prisma/client keys from package-lock.json before npm install. Remove once npm hoists these on its own.
